The '''Kendamar system''' was located in the [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kendamar]], home to the [[Kendamari Casinos]].<ref name="GG11" />
